extra.reason: Added date_added/last_played to library_tracks (migration v10), surfaced via FileEntry in read.rs, with sortable Date added / Last played track-list columns. Implemented independently of the fo2 schema widening.

Fixed by the Vite+ migration: @antfu/eslint-config is gone, vue/max-attributes-per-line is now fmt.singleAttributePerLine in vite.config.ts, and ESLint is scoped to **/*.vue so .beads/README.md is no longer linted. Gate is now: vp check && vp run lint.

Wired skip-back/forward to a new skipTrack() driven by the track list the current track was played from; buttons are disabled when there is no neighbour. Frontend stopgap — music-test-vibe-vw3 (real queue) should supersede it. Follow-ups: music-test-vibe-u98, music-test-vibe-xq5.
Fixed in wdio.conf.ts — vp run tauri build, plus a throw on non-zero status.

Implemented: cpal device enumeration (list_output_devices), SetOutputDevice StreamAction that rebuilds the AudioManager on the requested device while preserving playback state, a 1s watchdog that detects a vanished user-selected device via kira's pop_error() and falls back to system default (kira already auto-recovers to default on disconnect at the stream level; the watchdog just keeps our own custom-device bookkeeping/UI in sync and notifies the frontend), a Settings > Playback tab with a device picker, and persistence via prefs.json (output-device key) read at audio-thread startup. cargo check/clippy/fmt and vp check/lint all pass. Live UI run wasn't possible in this fresh worktree (no bootstrapped dev sqlite db) — filed music-test-vibe-qzw for that gap and music-test-vibe-eh6 to regenerate tauri-bindings.ts via the real specta build once possible.
Duplicate finder shipped: util + tests + /duplicates page + nav. Dep on fo2 removed — impl uses runtime FileEntry data, not new schema.
